## Components Tab

Once a valid product has been selected for a ticket, component values will be available for use under the Ticket Editor detail Components tab.

### Hydrocarbon Products

For hydrocarbon products, the Components tab displays data for Component Mass, Component Volume and Net Allowable Volume for CO2, N2 and C1 – C10.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 615;height: 427;" />

Each Component field in the Net Allowable column is read-only if that Component is being rolled into another Component based on the settings of the Min/Max Component to Report options in the Product Editor.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example">

If the Min Component to Report is set to C3, and the Max Component to Report is set to C3, then all components above and below C3 are set to read-only. In this case, the only row that is enabled in the Net Allowable column is C3.

</div>

</div>

### Non-Hydrocarbon Products

For non-hydrocarbon products, the NHC Components tab displays data for Component Mass and Component Mass Allowable.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 620;height: 432;" />

Negative values may be entered for any component in order to enter a customer balance that is for custody.
